environmental.altitude: no loss of performance to 10,000 ft (3,048 m)

features.expansion: two module slots (front and rear), EX4550-EM-8XSFP, EX4550-EM-8XT, EX4550-EM-2QSFP and EX4550-VC-128G
features.virtual-chassis: up to 10 switches, mixed with EX4200 and EX4500; a 10GBASE-T port joins only EX4550 switches

management.console: mini-USB console port (active) and RJ-45 console port (passive)
management.oob: one RJ-45 management port with link and status lamps

performance.expansion-ports: up to 48 ports with two 8-port modules, or 2 x 40 GbE with a QSFP+ module
performance.rj45-speeds: 10 GbE, 1 GbE or 100 Mbps on each fixed port

physical.weight-note: 19.4 lb (8.8 kg) with one power supply (Table 6)

power.power-input-ac: 100 to 120 VAC and 200 to 240 VAC, 50 to 60 Hz; 7.8 A and 3.8 A
power.power-input-dc: operating range -36 to -72 VDC, nominal -48 VDC, 7 A maximum
power.redundancy-note: two supplies, load sharing; do not mix AC and DC, or AFI and AFO

thermal.fans: three fan modules and a fan in each supply; the switch runs 30 seconds while one fan module is replaced
thermal.heat-btu-h: 1375 BTU an hour at the maximum system power (Table 22)

configs.description: EX4550-32T-AFI: one AC supply (JPSU-650W-AC-AFI) in slot 0, a cover panel in slot 1 and three back-to-front fan modules (EX4550-FAN-AFI). The labels are AFI and AIR IN.
configs.name: ac-b2f

configs.description: EX4550-32T-AFO: one AC supply (JPSU-650W-AC-AFO) in slot 0, a cover panel in slot 1 and three front-to-back fan modules (EX4550-FAN-AFO). The labels are AFO and AIR OUT (guide Table 4).
configs.name: ac-f2b

configs.description: EX4550-32T-DC-AFI: one DC supply (JPSU-650W-DC-AFI) in slot 0, a cover panel in slot 1 and three back-to-front fan modules (EX4550-FAN-AFI).
configs.name: dc-b2f

configs.description: EX4550-32T-DC-AFO: one DC supply (JPSU-650W-DC-AFO) in slot 0, a cover panel in slot 1 and three front-to-back fan modules (EX4550-FAN-AFO).
configs.name: dc-f2b

configs.description: The EX4550-32T-AFO with a second AC supply in slot 1, as the guide allows. An illustration, not an order code.
configs.name: two-psu

gaps.wanted: The part number of the mounting kit and the ear positions. The guide describes the front mount brackets and prints no part number for them.
The four modules a slot takes (EX4550-EM-8XSFP, EX4550-EM-8XT, EX4550-EM-2QSFP and EX4550-VC-128G) are not modelled. Each slot accepts its cover panel only.
The datasheet of the EX4550. The product page is retired and none is held, so the throughput, the typical power and the compliance list are not stated.
The handle colour of the fan modules and supplies. The guide's Tables 17, 20 and 24 give the labels only. The orange and blue of the EX4600 guide are used.

gaps.note: The rating label in Figure 6 prints an AC input of 3 A (100-240V, 60-50Hz). Table 22 gives 7.8 A at the low line and 3.8 A at the high line. The label is drawn as printed and the attribute carries Table 22.
gaps.wanted: which figure the real label prints, from a photograph of the rear plate

gaps.note: The registry's ganged-jack pitch is 13.97 mm; Figure 5 measures 13.47 mm. The figure's reading is used and is estimated.
gaps.wanted: the pitch of the jacks from Juniper, or a photograph at a known scale
The three round holes and the slot at the left end of the rear, the small lamp hole over the rating label and the captive screw in each fan strip. The guide's figure draws them and names none.
The USB revision. The guide names one USB port. It is drawn with the neutral usb2 skin.
The serial number label and the hazard marks, which the figures do not draw. The ESD warning mark is drawn as an outline of its triangle.
A flat drawing or photograph of the lid, the underside and the side panels.

`physical-context` on 7 bays (front 1, rear 6); `physical-context` on port group rj45 - unlocks ENTITY-MIB / Redfish correlation and monitoring overlays

airflow-colours.note: Tables 17, 20 and 24 give the label of each unit and the guide gives no handle colour for the EX4550. The reused supplies carry the orange and blue of the EX4600 guide, and the fan modules take the same two for the same airflow.

chassis.note: Guide Table 6, one table for both base models: 1.72 in (4.37 cm) high, 17.35 in (44.07 cm) wide, 18.50 in (46.99 cm) deep, 19.4 lb (8.8 kg) with one power supply, 2.4 lb a supply, 0.9 lb a 10GBASE-T module. So the height is 43.7 mm, the width 440.7 mm and the depth 469.9 mm. The width is the body: the front mount brackets extend it to 19 in, so they are not modelled.

colour.note: The figures are line drawings and no photograph is held, so the chassis colour is a mid grey. It is not a paint reference.

ears-and-kits.note: NOT MODELLED. The guide describes the front mount brackets (Table 6) and prints no part number for the mounting kit. The library holds no contract for it, so chassis.ears and chassis.kits are left out and a gap says so.

environment.note: Table 28: 0 to 40 C (32 to 104 F) for the 32T, up to 10,000 ft (3,048 m), 10 to 85 percent humidity noncondensing, GR-63 Zone 4.

fans-and-supplies.note: The three fan modules (EX4550-FAN-AFO and EX4550-FAN-AFI, Table 17) and the two supply slots (JPSU-650W-AC-AFO and -AFI, Table 20; JPSU-650W-DC-AFO and -AFI, Table 24) are field-replaceable units in bays. They are the same components as the 32F takes, and the supplies are the EX4600's by part number. Nothing on this chassis is a built-in unit that is not a bay.

front-controls.note: Figure 5, callouts 2 to 9: the same LCD panel, buttons, lamps, management port, RJ-45 console, USB port and mini-USB console port as the 32F, at the same positions: the plate 360.4 to 435.9 mm, the window 372.5 to 409.0 mm, the buttons at 417.3 mm, the lamps at 424.2 mm, and below the plate the jacks at 371.7, 393.4, 414.0 and 428.5 mm. The guide says the mini-USB console port is the active one and the RJ-45 console is passive on the EX4550.

gate-1.note: Figure 5 (the flat front drawing of the 32T) was rendered at 1200 dpi. Its body measures 4866 px wide and 488 px high, an aspect of 9.97 against the table's 10.08, 1.1 percent out, so it is read as orthographic at 0.0906 mm per pixel across and 0.0896 down. The callout bracket under the ports is not part of the body. Figure 6 (the rear, shared with the 32F) measures 5197 x 526 px, 9.88, 2 percent out, read at 0.0848 across and 0.0831 down. No photograph is held. Every position read off a figure is estimated, to about 0.3 mm on the front and 0.5 mm on the rear.

jack-orientation.note: Figure 5 shows the upper jack with its latch notch at the top and its contacts at the foot, and the lower jack the other way up. That is the library's stacked-jack convention: the upper row is the part turned 180 and the lower row as drawn.

junos-mark.note: Figure 5 prints a logo of the Junos operating system on the LCD plate and the maker's mark above the port field. Neither is drawn: the maker's mark has a reserved logo zone, the Junos mark has a region, and the plain model name EX4550 is drawn as text.

lifecycle.note: Searched for an end-of-life notice. Juniper's own page was not reached and the guide, dated 2020-12-15, states none. A reseller notice of 2019-03-08 gives 2019-06-30 as the last order date of the EX4550, and a third-party tracker (endoflife.ai) gives 2024-06-30 as the end of life. Both are estimated.

module-slots.note: Figures 2, 3 and 6: two module slots, one on the front panel at the left and one on the rear panel. Table 3 lists the four modules each takes, EX4550-EM-8XSFP, EX4550-EM-8XT, EX4550-EM-2QSFP and EX4550-VC-128G. Every model ships with a cover panel in each slot. THE MODULES ARE NOT MODELLED: each slot is a bay that accepts the cover panel alone, and the four modules are named here and in a gap.

port-lamps.note: Figure 5, Figure 19 and Table 14: each 10GBASE-T port has one link and activity lamp and no status lamp. A triangle sits at each top corner of a column: an up-pointing one at the left for the upper port and a down-pointing one at the right for the lower. The figure draws them at 11.6 mm down, inside the top rim of the upper jack, with a centre 1.6 and 11.4 mm from the column edge. They are drawn 3.4 mm higher, at 8.2 mm, because a lamp over another port's cell is an overlap that the model cannot say.

port-numbering.note: Printed on the metal and read off Figure 5: the numerals sit below the lower jack, the even numeral of the upper port at the left and the odd numeral of the lower port at the right of each column, 5.2 mm apart and 37.9 and 39.7 mm down. They stand on a 14.3 mm pitch, 0.8 mm wider than the jacks, so the offset from each jack changes along a block. The ports are 0 to 31 as printed. Interface names are not printed. The guide's default configuration names the network ports xe-0/0/0 to xe-0/0/31 and the expansion module ports xe-0/1/0 to xe-0/1/7, xe-0/2/0 to xe-0/2/7 and et-0/1/0 to et-0/2/1; they go here and not in the manifest.

ports.note: Figure 5, callout 10: 32 RJ-45 jacks in four blocks of four columns, each column a stacked pair. The jacks measure 148.7 px, 13.47 mm, apart, which is 3.6 percent under the registry's 13.97 mm pitch for a ganged jack, so the measured pitch of 13.5 mm is used and is estimated. The blocks start 707 px apart: the first jacks start at 106.4, 170.5, 234.5 and 298.6 mm, a stride of 64.06 mm, so the gutter is 64.06 - 4 x 13.5 = 10.06 mm. The jack rows are 14.5 mm apart at their centres (15.0 and 29.5 mm down) and the cells use the registry's aperture, 12.7 x 11.0, from 9.5 mm.

power.note: Table 22 (AC): 100 to 120 VAC and 200 to 240 VAC, 7.8 A and 3.8 A, 650 W output; the system maximum of an EX4550-32T with two EX4550-EM-8XT modules is 403 W and 1375 BTU an hour. That is the fully configured scope. Table 26 (DC): -36 to -72 VDC, 7 A at -48 VDC, 650 W output. The guide gives no typical figure.

rear-layout.note: Figure 6, the rear of the EX4550 in both base models (the guide draws one rear), read at 0.0848 mm across: power supply slot 0 at the left with its legend 0, slot 1 with its cover panel, the plate with the ESD point, the slot 1 legend, the rating label and the ESD warning mark, the rear module slot with its cover panel, then three fan slots numbered 1 to 3 from left to right, each preceded by a strip with its fan symbol, number and status lamp. The positions are those of the 32F rear.

sources.note: Juniper EX4550 Switch Hardware Guide, published 2020-12-15, 333 pages (Juniper Networks, copyright 2020; the PDF is the EX4550 guide of the EX Series documentation archive): Table 3 (the modules), Table 4 (the models), Table 6 (the chassis), Figures 2, 3, 5 and 6 (the panels), the lamp Tables 11 to 16, Table 17 (the fan modules), Tables 18 to 26 (the airflow, the supplies and their power). No datasheet of the EX4550 is held; the product page is retired. The held intake folders for the EX and QFX lines were read: they hold no studio photograph, stencil or 3D model of the EX4550, and the guide's figures are the only drawings. Terms: the document is Juniper's, read here for facts only, and nothing of it is copied into the library.

variants.note: Table 4: one front panel serves EX4550-32T-AFI, -AFO, -DC-AFI and -DC-AFO, so each is an orderable configuration. The guide lists no spare chassis of the 32T. Each ships with one supply in slot 0, a cover panel in slot 1 and three fan modules.

vents.note: Figure 5: a honeycomb band along the top from 127.0 to 355.0 mm, a column of five hexagons at each end of the port field and a row of small hexagons over the management jacks, as on the 32F. They are declared vents. The top band is drawn 5.9 mm deep and the figure's runs to 8.5 mm, so that the lamps, which are drawn 3.4 mm above the figure, do not print on it.
